criteria.name: User Registration and De-provisioning
criteria.description: Formal user registration and de-provisioning process shall be implemented.

criteria.name: Unique User Identification
criteria.description: All users shall have a unique identifier for access control purposes.

criteria.name: Encryption of Data at Rest
criteria.description: All sensitive data stored shall be encrypted using approved algorithms.

criteria.name: Firewall Configuration
criteria.description: Firewalls shall be properly configured and regularly reviewed.
